_note: Oathbound prototype audio. Load .ogg first, fall back to .mp3 (Phaser: this.load.audio(key, [ogg, mp3])). All files are original, synthesized by tools/audio/generate_audio.py.

mus_battle_loop.use: Battle map, from first turn until victory or defeat

mus_victory_sting.use: Battle won; fade battle loop out over 0.3 s first

mus_defeat_sting.use: Battle lost; fade battle loop out over 0.3 s first

unit_move.use: Unit starts a move (one per move order)

atk_bow.use: Bowhand fires (play before the hit or miss)

ability_cast.use: Hedge Mage casts an offensive ability

vow_sworn.use: Vow confirmed on the deployment screen

vow_kept.use: SIGNATURE: vow kept (Reckoning screen or battle end)

vow_lapsed.use: Battle ended before the vow resolved (no gain, no penalty)
